title: EcuDataMCP
text: Open public-data infrastructure for Ecuador Explore open data. Connect your AI assistant to verifiable public data from Ecuador: datasets, procedures, contracts, earthquakes, BCE indicators, IEM tables, RUC lookup and companies. Find the right source, query with clear limits, and always cite the official origin. Notice: Some tool definitions, parameters and descriptions were generated or assisted by AI. They may be incomplete or outdated; a tool may return partial results, reject valid parameters, or behave unexpectedly when the official source changes. Always check the response against the linked source and manually review results before using them for important decisions. Get started on GitHub See how it works ↓ 1,581 datasets 106 MCP tools 46 official sources 0 API keys The problem Less time in portals. More answers from your data. Ecuador publishes a huge amount of public data, but finding it means navigating different portals, checking separate catalogs, and guessing which file is current. EcuDataMCP gives your AI assistant the tools to do that work for you, and still cites the official source in every answer. How it works A traceable path. Four steps, from natural language to the official source. 01 Search search_ecuador searches datasets, procedures, regulations, contracts, and risk events by keyword, all at once. 02 Inspect get_dataset_info and list_dataset_resources check fields, formats, and dates before pulling any data. 03 Query query_resource_data filters the CKAN DataStore without downloading the whole file, or preview_resource_data for CSV, JSON, and XLSX. 04 Cite Every result links back to the official source (the dataset, the procedure, the SERCOP record) so you can verify it. What can you ask? It has never been this easy to navigate Ecuador's data. 46 official sources, in a single conversation. “What data does the SRI have on tax collection?” “Show me INEC's health datasets” “What are the requirements for getting a passport?” “Which retail-sector companies had the highest ROE this year?” “Look up this public tender in SERCOP” “How has consumer confidence changed according to the BCE over the last two years?” “Find a BCE IEM table on exports and show me its latest values.” “Which public SRI cubes are available for aggregate queries?” Sources Official data, always cited. EcuDataMCP never copies or stores these catalogs: every query goes live against the source portal. 46 sources grouped by theme — Central Bank, SRI, INEC, Supercías, Superbancos and more — each tied to its own institution. Open data catalogs Procedures, regulations & public procurement Risk & natural hazards Economy & finance Statistics & demographics Agriculture Energy Labour & employment Oversight & transparency Transport & civil aviation Health Telecommunications See the 46 sources, grouped → The backstage Open-source MCP server. EcuDataMCP runs as a FastMCP server in Python, exposed over Streamable HTTP or stdio. There is no database of its own: every tool calls the matching official portal live (CKAN, gob.ec, SERCOP, BCE, Supercías, IG-EPN, SGR) and returns the formatted response. Unified entry points Open Data Government procedures ANDA (INEC) Macroeconomics (BCE) Companies (Supercías) Regulations & contracts Risk & earthquakes Exploration BCE and specialized series INEC: statistics, BIINEC, and census SRI: RUC and tax collection SIPA, Contraloría, and Superbancos CENACE, SUT, and IG-EPN Research utilities SEPS and the popular and solidarity economy IESS: institutional documents INEVAL: educational evaluation Civil aviation (DGAC) ARCOTEL: telecommunications ARCSA: sanitary registry Additional sector sources See the 106 tools in the Reference → Connect your assistant Copy your client's configuration. Run the server locally (Docker or uv run , see the README ) and point your MCP client at http://localhost:8000/mcp . Quick option If your assistant has terminal access, hand it the repo link and let it install everything for you: Copy Clone https://github.com/DweskZ/EcuDataMCP, install its dependencies with uv sync, and register it as an MCP server in my client using stdio mode with `uv run --directory <clone-path> python main.py --transport stdio`. Verify the server responds before calling it done. Always review what your assistant changes (config files, commands run) before confirming. This option only works with assistants that can run commands on their own: today that's Claude Code , Cursor , and Windsurf in agent mode. With ChatGPT, chat-only Claude.ai, or other terminal-less clients, use the manual configuration below. Claude Desktop Cursor VS Code ChatGPT Claude Code Gemini CLI Le Chat (Mistral) Windsurf HuggingChat Add this to your Claude Desktop config file ( ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json on macOS, %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json on Windows): Copy { "mcpServers": { "ecuador-datos": { "command": "npx", "args": [ "mcp-remote", "http://localhost:8000/mcp" ] } } } Open Cursor Settings Search for "MCP" Add a new MCP server: Copy { "mcpServers": { "ecuador-datos": { "url": "http://localhost:8000/mcp", "transport": "http" } } } Add to your mcp.json file (run MCP: Open User Configuration from the command palette): Copy { "servers": { "ecuador-datos": { "url": "http://localhost:8000/mcp", "type": "http" } } } *Available on paid plans (Plus, Pro, Team, Enterprise).* Go to Settings > Apps and connectors Open Advanced settings and enable Developer mode In Settings > Connectors > Browse connectors , click Add a new connector Set the URL: http://localhost:8000/mcp Copy claude mcp add --transport http ecuador-datos http://localhost:8000/mcp Add to ~/.gemini/settings.json : Copy { "mcpServers": { "ecuador-datos": { "httpUrl": "http://localhost:8000/mcp" } } } Go to Intelligence > Connectors Add connector > Custom MCP Connector Name: "Ecuador Datos" / URL: http://localhost:8000/mcp Add to ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json : Copy { "mcpServers": { "ecuador-datos": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "mcp-remote", "http://localhost:8000/mcp"] } } } In the chat, click the + icon > MCP Servers > Manage MCP Servers Add Server with name "Ecuador Datos" and URL http://localhost:8000/mcp No friction Ready to use, no setup of your own. No API key All sources are public data, no authentication. No account There is no sign-up or user account to create. 100% public data Under an open license, exactly as the Ecuadorian state publishes it. No telemetry The server runs on your machine and never logs or sends any of your queries. FAQ Got more questions? What is EcuDataMCP? An open-source MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that helps your AI assistant discover and query Ecuador's open government data: datasets, procedures, regulations, public contracts, risk events, earthquakes, Central Bank indicators, and companies. What is MCP? Model Context Protocol is an open standard for connecting AI assistants to external tools and data sources, while keeping control over what the model can do and what data it can read. What assistants can I use? Any MCP-compatible client: Claude Desktop, Claude Code, ChatGPT (paid plans), Cursor, VS Code, Gemini CLI, Le Chat, Windsurf, HuggingChat, and more. Do I need an API key? No. Every source the server uses is public data with no authentication. Is this an official service of the Ecuadorian government? No. EcuDataMCP is an independent, open-source project that queries the same public sources the Ecuadorian state already publishes. It is not affiliated with any institution. Does the server store my questions? There is no telemetry. The server runs locally on your machine, and every query goes straight from the MCP client to the matching official portal. What formats does it support? In-memory preview of CSV, TSV, JSON, GeoJSON, and XLSX; filtered tabular queries via the CKAN DataStore when the resource supports it. Why does the connection to the Open Data portal sometimes fail? www.datosabiertos.gob.ec sometimes rejects connections coming from outside Latin America (403 error). If you see this, run the server from a connection with an exit point in Ecuador or the region (a VPN, for example). The procedures and institutions tools use a different portal and don't have this issue. Can I contribute? Yes, the project is MIT-licensed and accepts pull requests. See the guide at Contribute . Ecuador's open data, with your favorite AI assistant. View on GitHub

text: Reference All 106 tools , one by one. Find a tool by name, source, or task. Open only the group and detail you need. 106 tools · open a group to see its details. Expand groups Collapse groups Unified entry points 3 Show list_capabilities Summarizes sources, tools, prompts, and server limits. Describe what this Ecuador MCP can do: sources, key tools, prompts and limits. Call this first when you are unsure which tool to use. Parameter Type Default Description format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. search_ecuador Searches datasets, orgs, procedures, regulations, contracts, and risk events all at once. Unified search across Ecuador open data, trámites, regulations, contracts and risk events. Use this as the first step for broad questions. Then drill down with get_dataset_info, query_resource_data, get_tramite_info, get_regulacion_info, get_contrato_info or search_eventos_riesgo. Parameter Type Default Description query str required Search terms in Spanish (e.g. "salud", "RUC", "medicinas") limit int 5 Max results per section (default 5, max 10) format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. lookup_ubicacion Provinces, cantons, and parishes (INEC code, region, population). Look up Ecuador DPA geography: provinces, cantons and parroquias (INEC codes). - nivel='provincia' | 'canton' | 'parroquia' | 'auto' - For parroquias, filter with canton= and/or provincia= (recommended) Parameter Type Default Description query str empty Name or code (e.g. "Pichincha", "Cuenca", "Tumbaco", "170150") region str empty Optional natural region for provinces/cantons provincia str empty Optional province filter canton str empty Optional canton filter (useful for parroquias) nivel str auto auto | provincia | canton | parroquia format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. Open Data 10 Show search_datasets Search datasets by keyword. Supports filtering by category. Search for datasets on Ecuador's open data portal (www.datosabiertos.gob.ec). This is the starting point for exploring government data from 98+ public institutions. Use short, specific queries in Spanish for best results. Typical workflow: search_datasets → list_dataset_resources → preview_resource_data Parameter Type Default Description query str required Search keywords (e.g. "empleo", "salud", "presupuesto", "SRI recaudación") page int 1 Page number (1-based, default: 1) page_size int 20 Results per page (default: 20, max: 100) category str empty Optional category filter (e.g. "sal" for Salud, "edu" for Educación). Use list_categories to see all available categories. source str nacional "nacional" (default, www.datosabiertos.gob.ec) or "cuenca" (cuencaendatos.cuenca.gob.ec, independent municipal portal) format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. list_recent_datasets The most recently updated datasets on the portal. List the most recently updated datasets on Ecuador's open data portal. Useful to discover new or freshly refreshed government data without a specific keyword. Sorted by metadata_modified descending. Parameter Type Default Description page int 1 Page number (1-based, default 1) page_size int 15 Results per page (default 15, max 50) source str nacional "nacional" (default, www.datosabiertos.gob.ec) or "cuenca" (cuencaendatos.cuenca.gob.ec, independent municipal portal) format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. get_dataset_info Detailed dataset metadata: title, description, organization, tags, license, dates. Get detailed metadata about a specific dataset from Ecuador's open data portal. Returns title, description, organization, tags, resource count, creation/update dates, license, update frequency, the publisher's source URL (where the entity keeps the authoritative data, if any), and any custom metadata fields the publisher added. Parameter Type Default Description dataset_id str required The dataset ID or slug (e.g. "registro-estadistico-de-recursos-y-actividades-de-salud-2019") source str nacional "nacional" (default, www.datosabiertos.gob.ec) or "cuenca" (cuencaendatos.cuenca.gob.ec, independent municipal portal) format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. list_dataset_resources Lists all files (resources) in a dataset with format, size, URL, and creation/modification dates. List all resources (files) in a dataset with their metadata. Returns resource ID, title, format, size, download URL, and creation/ last-modified dates for each file. The dates let you tell whether a dataset's files are periodic snapshots (compare last_modified across resources to find the most recent one) before reading any of them. Also flags groups of resources whose names look like a periodic series (e.g. weekly files) — that's only a hint that they might need combining or picking the latest one; it does not tell you which, since that depends on the dataset (some periodic files replace previous ones, others complement them). Next step: use preview_resource_data on a CSV resource to see its contents, or use get_resource_info for detailed metadata. Parameter Type Default Description dataset_id str required The dataset ID or slug source str nacional "nacional" (default, www.datosabiertos.gob.ec) or "cuenca" (cuencaendatos.cuenca.gob.ec, independent municipal portal) format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. get_resource_info Detailed information about a specific file. Get detailed information about a specific resource (file) from Ecuador's open data portal. Returns format, size, MIME type, download URL, and dataset association. For CSV files, you can then use preview_resource_data to see the actual data. Parameter Type Default Description resource_id str required The resource UUID source str nacional "nacional" (default, www.datosabiertos.gob.ec) or "cuenca" (cuencaendatos.cuenca.gob.ec, independent municipal portal) format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. preview_resource_data Preview of CSV/TSV, JSON/GeoJSON, or Excel (XLS/XLSX) as a table (max 5 MB). Download and preview a resource from Ecuador's open data portal. Supports CSV/TSV, JSON/GeoJSON and Excel (XLSX). Returns the first N rows as a formatted table so the model can inspect data without a local download. Geometry/WKT columns are dropped from the table (they can be tens of KB per cell); CSV columns in European decimal notation (7.760,2) are normalized to standard notation (7760.2). Max download size: 5 MB. For large tabular DataStore resources prefer query_resource_data. Parameter Type Default Description resource_id str required The resource UUID (get it from list_dataset_resources) rows int 20 Number of data rows to preview (default: 20, max: 100) source str nacional "nacional" (default, www.datosabiertos.gob.ec) or "cuenca" (cuencaendatos.cuenca.gob.ec, independent municipal portal) format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. download_resource Downloads the raw file of a resource as base64 (max 5 MB), for formats that can't be previewed as a table (.rar, .tar.gz, etc.). Download a resource's raw bytes from Ecuador's open data portal, base64-encoded. Use this for formats preview_resource_data can't parse into a table (.rar, .tar.gz, legacy .xls, or anything unrecognized) — it fetches the file as-is instead of trying to read it. Max size: 5 MB (same cap as preview_resource_data). Larger files come back with an error and the direct URL instead, since they'd be too big to embed in a response. Call with format="json" to get the actual file content — the default format="text" only confirms the download and tells you to retry with json; it never includes content_base64. Parameter Type Default Description resource_id str required The resource UUID (get it from list_dataset_resources) source str nacional "nacional" (default, www.datosabiertos.gob.ec) or "cuenca" (cuencaendatos.cuenca.gob.ec, independent municipal portal) format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. query_resource_data Tabular query via the CKAN DataStore (filters, text, pagination) without downloading the file. Query a tabular resource via CKAN DataStore without downloading the full file. Prefer this over preview_resource_data when the resource is in the DataStore (most CSV resources on the portal). Supports full-text query, JSON filters, sorting and pagination. Parameter Type Default Description resource_id str required Resource UUID (from list_dataset_resources) query str empty Optional full-text search across datastore fields filters_json str empty Optional JSON object of exact field filters, e.g. '{"provincia":"Pichincha"}' rows int 20 Number of records to return (default 20, max 100) offset int 0 Pagination offset (default 0) sort str empty Optional sort expression, e.g. "anio desc" source str nacional "nacional" (default, www.datosabiertos.gob.ec) or "cuenca" (cuencaendatos.cuenca.gob.ec, independent municipal portal) format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. detect_series_pattern For datasets that publish one file per period: tells whether each new file replaces the previous ones (cumulative) or complements them (incremental). When a dataset publishes one file per period (weekly/monthly), it's not always clear whether each new file replaces the previous ones (cumulative -- only the newest file matters) or complements them (incremental -- every file must be combined). Downloads the two most recent resources from the periodic-name group list_dataset_resources already detects, finds a date/period-like column by header name (fecha, mes, año, periodo, semana, ...), and compares which period values appear in both files. High overlap → cumulative; near-zero overlap → incremental; if no period column is found or the overlap is ambiguous, returns indeterminado rather than guessing. A heuristic over a sample of up to 500 rows per file -- confirm with preview_resource_data if the result is close to the threshold. Parameter Type Default Description dataset_id str required The dataset ID or slug resource_id_new str | None none Optional -- newer resource ID to compare (auto-detected from the dataset's periodic-name group if omitted) resource_id_old str | None none Optional -- older resource ID to compare (auto-detected if omitted). Both resource_id_new/resource_id_old must be given together, or neither. source str nacional "nacional" (default, www.datosabiertos.gob.ec) or "cuenca" (cuencaendatos.cuenca.gob.ec, independent municipal portal) format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. search_sri_datasets Search across ~130 SRI files published outside the CKAN portal: RUC registry by province, tax collection, sales/purchases, vehicles, CEL, data dictionaries. Search the SRI's open datasets page (sri.gob.ec/datasets) for direct file links. Covers ~130 CSV/XLSX/ZIP files not reachable through search_datasets (they live on the SRI's own site, not the CKAN DataStore): RUC catastro by province, recaudación by year, ventas/compras, vehículos nuevos, comprobantes electrónicos (CEL), inscripciones/cierres, plus variable dictionaries (*_DD.xlsx). Returns direct URLs, not the file contents — download them yourself or via download_resource. Parameter Type Default Description query str empty Free text matched against the file's label or URL (accent-insensitive), e.g. "recaudación", "vehiculos", "Pichincha". Empty returns all files. limit int 30 Max results (default 30, max 100) offset int 0 Pagination offset over the matched set format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. Government procedures 5 Show search_tramites Search Ecuadorian government procedures (ID card, passport, RUC, driver's license, etc.). Search for government procedures (trámites) on Ecuador's official portal gob.ec. Best approach: provide an institution_id to get that institution's trámites. Add a query to filter results by keyword (filters by name and description). When query is provided with institution_id, ALL pages of that institution's trámites are fetched and filtered, so you always get the most relevant results. Common institution IDs: - "8" = SRI (Servicio de Rentas Internas) — impuestos, RUC, facturación - "23" = Registro Civil — cédula, partidas de nacimiento - "62" = ANT — licencias de conducir, matriculación vehicular - "16" = Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores — pasaportes, apostilla - "5" = IESS — seguro social, pensiones, fondos de reserva Use list_instituciones to find more institution IDs. Parameter Type Default Description query str empty Keywords to filter results (e.g. "RUC", "inscripción RUC persona natural"). Each word must appear in the trámite name or description. institution_id str empty Institution ID (strongly recommended for relevant results) page int 1 Page number (1-based, default: 1). Ignored when query is provided (all pages are searched automatically). format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. get_tramite_info Full detail: requirements, procedure, cost, estimated time. Get detailed information about a specific government procedure (trámite). Returns the procedure name, description, requirements, beneficiaries, cost, and the institution responsible. Get the tramite_id from search_tramites. Parameter Type Default Description tramite_id str required The procedure ID (e.g. "18009") format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. get_tramite_estadisticas Monthly usage/complaint transparency series for one trámite, since 2021. Monthly usage and complaint series (atenciones/quejas) for one specific trámite. Different from get_tramite_info: this is how many people were actually attended each month, and how many complaints were filed, since gob.ec started publishing this (mid-2021). Get tramite_id from search_tramites. There is no bulk endpoint -- this fetches one trámite's series at a time (currently a few dozen months, no pagination needed). Parameter Type Default Description tramite_id str required The procedure ID (e.g. "11752") format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. list_instituciones List Ecuador's public institutions. List or search public institutions registered on Ecuador's gob.ec portal. If a query is provided, searches across all institutions by name or acronym. Without a query, returns a paginated list. Common institutions: SRI (ID: 8), Registro Civil (ID: 23), ANT (ID: 62), Cancillería (ID: 16), IESS (ID: 5), Ministerio de Salud, INEC, BCE. Parameter Type Default Description query str empty Optional search term (e.g. "SRI", "salud", "rentas") page int 1 Page number (1-based, default: 1, only used without query) format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. get_institucion_info Detail of an institution (sector, website, description). Get detailed information about a public institution registered on gob.ec. Returns name, acronym, sector, description, website and portal URL. Get the institucion_id from list_instituciones. Common IDs: SRI=8, IESS=5, Registro Civil=23, ANT=62, Cancillería=16. Parameter Type Default Description institucion_id str required Institution ID (e.g. "8") format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. ANDA (INEC) 3 Show search_anda Search INEC's ANDA catalog of surveys and censuses (NADA/IHSN). Indicates whether each survey has downloadable microdata. Search INEC's ANDA catalog (anda.inec.gob.ec) of surveys and censuses. ANDA runs on NADA (World Bank/IHSN), separate from datosabiertos.gob.ec. It catalogs 437+ INEC surveys/censuses with metadata (title, year, authoring entity). Not every entry has downloadable microdata — many are aggregate-only publications (e.g. price indices); each result says so. Follow up with get_anda_survey_info(idno) for full metadata on one survey. Parameter Type Default Description query str empty Search keywords (e.g. "empleo", "REEM", "censo agropecuario") limit int 10 Max results (default: 10, max: 50) format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. get_anda_survey_info Full metadata for an ANDA survey: summary, variables, confidentiality, and contact. Get full metadata for one ANDA (INEC) survey/census by its idno. Get the idno from search_anda results — it's the string identifier (e.g. "IDD-ECU-INEC-CGTPE-DECON-ENESEM-2023-v1.3"), not the numeric id. Returns scope/abstract, variable count, whether microdata is actually downloadable, confidentiality terms, and a contact email for requesting restricted data when it isn't. Parameter Type Default Description idno str required Survey identifier from search_anda (the "idno" field) format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. download_anda_microdata Direct download links for an ANDA survey's microdata files. Get direct download links for an ANDA survey's microdata files. Automates ANDA's one-click usage-terms step (research/statistical use only, no re-identifying respondents, cite the source — see get_anda_survey_info for the full text) to reveal the file list. Check get_anda_survey_info first: aggregate-only surveys (microdatos_disponibles false) have no files here. Returns direct URLs, not the file contents — the files are typically multi-MB ZIPs (SPSS .sav inside), too large to embed in a tool result. Download them with the returned URL. Parameter Type Default Description idno str required Survey identifier from search_anda (the "idno" field) format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. Macroeconomics (BCE) 2 Show search_indicadores_bce Search the Central Bank of Ecuador's statistical catalog (monetary/financial, public finance, external sector, real sector). Search the Banco Central del Ecuador (BCE) statistical catalog. Covers monetary/financial statistics, public finances, external sector (foreign trade), and real sector (GDP, employment/ unemployment, consumer confidence, oil production, cement production, and more) — each result is an indicator group (id_grupo) whose time series data you fetch with get_indicador_bce. Some groups hold a single series, others dozens under a broader title (e.g. "desempleo" is a series inside the "mercado laboral" group, not a group of its own — matched here too, not just group titles). Does NOT cover Ecuador's own inflation (CPI) or poverty statistics — those are INEC's domain, try search_anda instead. First call after the cache expires (24h) takes ~10-15s: matching against series names, not just group titles, means fetching every group's metadata (~78 groups) once to build the search index. Cached after that. Parameter Type Default Description query str empty Free text matched against the group's description, its section/subsection, and its individual series labels (accent-insensitive) limit int 20 Max results (default 20, max 100) offset int 0 Pagination offset over the matched set format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. get_indicador_bce Time series for an indicator by id_grupo: configurable period, frequency, and unit (defaults set per group). Time series data for one Banco Central del Ecuador (BCE) indicator group. Use search_indicadores_bce first to find the id_grupo. Frequency and unit vary by group (e.g. "Mensual"/"Millones de USD" for money supply, "Trimestral"/"Porcentaje" for GDP growth) — omit them to get the group's default, or check the error message for the valid options if you guess wrong. Parameter Type Default Description id_grupo int required The group id from search_indicadores_bce. desde str empty Start period as YYYY-MM. Defaults to the earliest available period for the chosen frequency. hasta str empty End period as YYYY-MM. Defaults to the latest available period for the chosen frequency. frecuencia str empty Semanal | Mensual | Trimestral | Anual. Defaults to the group's first available frequency. unidad str empty Varies by group (e.g. "Millones de USD", "Indice", "Porcentaje"). Defaults to the first one available for the chosen frequency. format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. Companies (Supercías) 6 Show search_companias Search the Superintendency of Companies' directory (226k+, by name/RUC, province, legal status). Search Ecuador's company registry (Superintendencia de Compañías). Covers 226k+ companies with legal status, incorporation date, legal representative, registered capital, economic activity (CIIU) and address. Source is a daily-refreshed government export, cached up to 6h server-side — the first call after the cache expires can take ~30-40s to download and parse (~35 MB, 226k rows). Parameter Type Default Description query str empty Free text matched against company name or RUC (accent-insensitive) provincia str empty Optional province filter, e.g. "PICHINCHA" (substring match) situacion_legal str empty Optional legal status filter, e.g. "ACTIVA", "DISOLUCIÓN" limit int 20 Max results (default 20, max 100) offset int 0 Pagination offset over the matched set format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. get_compania_info Full company profile by RUC: legal representative, subscribed capital, CIIU code, address. Get full registry details for a company by RUC (Superintendencia de Compañías). Returns legal status, incorporation date, legal representative, registered capital, economic activity (CIIU), address and last balance-sheet year. Use search_companias first if you don't have the exact RUC. Parameter Type Default Description ruc str required The company's 13-digit RUC format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. search_ranking Rank/filter companies by financial indicators (year, CIIU, any column); requires the local financial database build. Rank/filter Supercías companies by financial indicators for a fiscal year. Filter by year and/or CIIU level-1 economic activity (single letter, e.g. "C" for manufacturing), sorted by any indicator column (defaults to the dataset's own precomputed posicion_general). Each result includes the company's nombre/ruc alongside its financials. Covers only the last few cached fiscal years, not the full history. Use get_financials for one company's full detail, or get_compania_info for legal/registry data (address, legal representative, etc.). Parameter Type Default Description anio int | None none Optional fiscal year filter. ciiu_n1 str empty Optional CIIU level-1 filter, e.g. "C", "G", "I". order_by str posicion_general Column to sort ascending by (e.g. "posicion_general", "activos", "roe"). Falls back to posicion_general if unknown. limit int 20 Max results (default 20, max 100). offset int 0 Pagination offset. format str text Output format: `text` (default) or `json`. get_financials A company's financial history by filing number or RUC: revenue, assets, equity, ~38 ratios (liquidity, leverage, profitability). Get a company's financial history from Supercías balance-sheet filings. Returns revenue, assets, equity, profit, employee count, and financial ratios (liquidity, leverage, profitability) per fiscal year. Lists infoMIES's (statistics portal of the former MIES) monthly database files for one program: "anc" or "is". Richer than this project's existing CKAN coverage for the same programs, which only has quarterly snapshots. Confirmed live: only the current year has one file per month so far; every closed year (2019-2025) has exactly one file, the December/year-end snapshot. Files are .rar (outside this project's supported-format list) — only metadata and the direct URL are returned. Parameter Type Default Description serie str required "anc" (non-contributory insurance / economic inclusion) or "is" (SIIMIES users / social inclusion). anio int | None none Specific year to fetch, e.g. 2024. Omit to fetch every known year and aggregate (multiple cold-cache requests). query str empty Free text matched (accent-insensitive) against the file's label, year, or URL, e.g. "julio", "2023". Empty returns all files for the selected year(s). format str text text | json search_infomies_boletines_zonales infoMIES zonal bulletins, by zone or consolidated by year. Lists infoMIES's zonal bulletin files. Two distinct series live under this name: modo="zonal" (default), the original "Boletín Zonal" series (one .rar per zone per month), discontinued (2017-2021, nothing since); modo="consolidado", the newer "Reporte Boletines Zonales" successor (one consolidated XLSX per year, 2021-2026, still being updated). Both return metadata and direct URLs only — the .rar files are additionally outside this project's supported-format list. Parameter Type Default Description modo str zonal "zonal" or "consolidado". zona str empty Required for modo="zonal": one of "zona-1-bz".."zona-9-bz". Ignored for modo="consolidado". Leave empty with modo="zonal" to get the list of valid zone keys. anio int | None none Specific year to fetch. For "zonal", omit to fetch every year found (typically 2017-2021). For "consolidado", omit to fetch 2021-2026. query str empty Free text matched (accent-insensitive) against the file's label, year, or URL. format str text text | json search_trabajo_boletin_anual Annual statistical bulletin on Ecuador's labor market. Lists known editions of the Ministry of Labor's annual statistical bulletin on Ecuador's labor market — a PDF report sourced from INEC's ENEMDU survey plus the ministry's own administrative registries. Not a complete historical series — only 3 editions are known (2020, 2021, 2022). The page that once listed multiple editions cannot be scraped live today and now only links the 2022 edition; 2020 and 2021 were recovered from a January 2024 Wayback Machine snapshot. Parameter Type Default Description query str empty Free text matched (accent-insensitive) against the edition's year, title, or URL, e.g. "2021". Empty returns all known editions. format str text text | json search_salarios_sectoriales Ecuador's sectoral minimum wage tables. Lists Ecuador's sectoral minimum wage table documents — wage floors per branch of economic activity, set by the Consejo Nacional de Trabajo y Salarios, distinct from the single national Salario Básico Unificado. Scraped from the Ministry of Labor's document library, which actually responds and lists stable per-document download links unlike the ministry's dynamic pages. Confirmed coverage: one entry per year for 2020-2025. No 2026 table has been published — the 2025 table remains in force by default. Parameter Type Default Description anio int | None none Filter to this year (as printed in the document's own title). None returns every year found. format str text text | json No tool matches that search. Missing a tool you need? Propose it. Contribute

title: Examples
text: The problem, first Real questions, cited data. Ask a general AI assistant about Ecuador and it's common for it to invent figures with total confidence: there isn't enough Ecuador in the data it was trained on, and it has no way to verify anything in real time. Give it EcuDataMCP's tools and it stops guessing: it searches the official portal, cites the source, and the number it returns is real. These ten examples show that difference. search_sismos “What earthquakes has the Geophysical Institute recorded in Ecuador recently?” Returns the IG-EPN's latest catalog: magnitude, depth, location, and review status (automatic or reviewed) for each event, with a direct link to the official bulletin. See Sismicidad Ecuador live ↗ www.igepn.edu.ec ↗ And the rest of the universe “How many active taxpayers does the SRI's RUC registry have right now?” search_sri_datasets The most recent registry records 2,904,355 active taxpayers, summing the TOTAL column, not counting rows. sri.gob.ec/datasets ↗ “How many people collected IESS unemployment insurance last month?” query_resource_data June 2026: 2,561 beneficiaries , USD 836,716.99 in total, excluding the TOTAL: row embedded in the file. datosabiertos.gob.ec (IESS) ↗ “What's the WTI oil price right now, per the Central Bank?” get_bce_indicador_diario USD 83.40 per barrel as of August 30, 2026 — the Central Bank's daily series (history back to 2015). contenido.bce.fin.ec ↗ “What are the requirements for getting a passport?” get_tramite_info Proof of payment, a valid ID card, and — if it's a renewal — the previous passport or the loss report, straight from the gob.ec portal. gob.ec ↗ “Who won the school-desks tender for Universidad Técnica Luis Vargas Torres, and for how much?” search_contratos Tito Marcelo Coral Guevara, for USD 130,100 via electronic reverse auction (March 2023). compraspublicas.gob.ec ↗ “How has consumer confidence evolved this year?” get_indicador_bce The Global Consumer Confidence Indicator rose to 36.40 in May 2026, up from 36.07 in March — the BCE's monthly series. contenido.bce.fin.ec ↗ “Which companies have the best ROE in a given sector?” search_ranking A ranking across ~38 financial ratios (liquidity, leverage, profitability), filterable by CIIU code and year. supercias.gob.ec ↗ “Which INEC surveys have downloadable microdata on employment?” search_anda The NADA/IHSN catalog shows exactly which surveys carry downloadable microdata, with the direct link. anda.inec.gob.ec ↗ “What rules regulate a given activity, with an Official Register reference?” get_regulacion_info The regulation's detail, with a direct link to the Official Register PDF. gob.ec ↗ Got a question these sources could answer? Try it on GitHub

title: About
text: About A bridge between public data and your AI assistant. EcuDataMCP exists because finding a public data point in Ecuador almost always means guessing which portal it's on, under what name, and in what format. The server gives your assistant the tools to do that search for you, and always lets you verify against the official source. History Where it comes from. EcuDataMCP started as DweskZ/EcuDataMCP . Since then, Luis Figueroa and Daniel Sánchez Pazmiño have maintained it together: new sources (SRI Datasets, BCE, Supercías auditors), more robust error and download handling, and this site, so connecting the server doesn't depend on reading a README end to end. Independence Not a service of the Ecuadorian state. EcuDataMCP is an independent, open-source project. It queries the same public sources that Ecuadorian government institutions already publish (CKAN, gob.ec, SERCOP, BCE, Supercías, IG-EPN, SGR), but it is not affiliated with, funded by, or endorsed by any of them. Every answer links to the official source precisely so that distinction stays clear: what you see is what the portal publishes, not a copy. License & maintenance MIT, and open for you to use. The full codebase (MCP server and this site) is MIT . It's maintained by Luis Figueroa and Daniel Sánchez Pazmiño . Want to add a source, a tool, or fix something? Start at Contribute . Ecuador's open data, with your favorite AI assistant. View on GitHub

title: Contribute
text: Contribute Add your source , your tool , your idea. EcuDataMCP is MIT-licensed and accepts pull requests. You don't need to be an expert in MCP or the whole project stack: most contributions touch a single piece. Contribution flow Fork, branch, PR. 01 Fork Fork DweskZ/EcuDataMCP to your account. 02 Branch git checkout -b feature/new-tool 03 Commit git commit -m 'feat: add new tool' 04 Pull Request Push to your fork and open a PR describing the change. MCP server Python, uv, pytest. The server lives in tools/ , helpers/ , resources/ , and prompts/ . It requires Python 3.11+ and uv . Copy uv sync uv run pytest uv run ruff check . A new tool is usually three files: the function in tools/ , its registration in tools/__init__.py , and a test in tests/ . Every missing source, every tool short on coverage, is a possible contribution. View on GitHub
